content: Baxyl and Runovia, which contain hyaluronan and herbal components, are indicated for promoting healthy joint mobility and lubrication. They also support the maintenance of cartilage and joint tissues. The recommended dosage is 5 mL taken orally twice daily (PO BID). There are no known results regarding certain outcomes, and hypersensitivity to gram-positive bacterial proteins is a contraindication. The safety and efficacy of these products have not been established for use in children. Regarding pregnancy and lactation, there is no specific category assigned (Pregnancy Category: N/A; Lactation: N/A). However, in general, these products are considered acceptable, as controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. Cost information and comprehensive interaction data are not provided.
